rulesTestNames: reads a trip only where one assignment covers its pickup and hotel
lets a hotel desk read only trips still en route to its hotel
read: get and list where one reconciliation viewer, dispatcher or coordinator assignment covers the trip's pickup point and hotel together (programAccessViews tripRoutes), and the programme owner; the hotel desk covering the destination hotel reads trips still en route (a query naming programId, hotelKey and status); never while deleted
write: server only; written from transportTrips, programGuests and programTravelLegs
migrationNotes: Exactly the row the retired listProgramTrips callable returned, with the manifest's guest names from the recorded dispatch snapshot; the trip's notes, rate, driver and account ids stay in transportTrips. Hotel desks also read a trip's pickup point id, vendor id, kind, arrival time and void reason, which getProgramHotelInbound did not return. The program-trip-views copy-forward migration creates views for sources that predate the triggers and leaves views the triggers wrote alone.
